baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative ادخلوها, بسلام, and يوم الخلود bind crossing, safety, duration, and permanence.
baseline_models.mechanism: A boundary is crossed into an interior whose freedom from harm persists as the defining condition of an extended time.

activation_trace.role: Literal ingress supplies the boundary-crossing action.
Freedom from defect and harm supplies the condition governing entry.
A duration rather than only daylight supplies the temporal container.
Stable persistence resistant to decay makes safety durative.

changed_reading.before: A generic welcome into a safe place.
changed_reading.after: Cross into an interior where immunity from harm is the enduring condition of the whole duration.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: بسلام can carry peace after conflict, while الخلود can carry attachment and staying.
baseline_models.mechanism: Entry does not merely remove danger; it closes antagonism and converts arrival into settled belonging.

activation_trace.role: Ingress marks the threshold at which status changes.
Reconciliation opposed to war makes the threshold a cessation of antagonism.
Adhesion and prolonged staying turn cessation into settled belonging.

changed_reading.before: Safety accompanies the act of entry.
changed_reading.after: Entry ratifies a lasting peace in which the entrants become settled inhabitants.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier command to cast offenders into punishment provides a coercive spatial anti-pattern; the focus instead addresses the entrants directly and joins ingress to سلام, making the same inward motion welcomed rather than discarded.

activation_trace.role: Direct ingress supplies the focus motion and its addressed participants.
Freedom from harm qualifies the destination and the mode of crossing.
Throwing something until it lies cast supplies the coercive anti-pole to invited ingress.
Painful punishment identifies what governs the cast destination, sharpening the reversal by سلام.

structural_cues: 50:24 and 50:26 use dual commands of casting into a destination; 50:34 uses a plural command of entering it.
Punishment and سلام occupy parallel destination frames with opposite conditions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed imperatives, casting, punishment, ingress, and safety; I infer that the contrast assigns welcome and participant agency to the latter, while the live alternative is that both remain equally authoritative commands.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports relocation into safety.
changed_reading.after: The verse reverses punitive thrownness: those addressed cross the threshold as welcomed participants under a condition of no harm.

context_deltas.mechanism: The destination is driven near while the person comes bearing a repeatedly returning orientation; ادخلوها becomes the meeting threshold of movement from both sides, followed by lasting attachment.

activation_trace.role: Ingress supplies the final crossing after convergence.
Attachment and staying convert convergence into residence.
A push toward nearness makes the destination itself one moving side of the encounter.
Coming and arrival supply motion from the entrant's side.
Habitual return makes arrival the completion of an established orientation.

structural_cues: The passive nearness of the garden in 50:31, personal coming in 50:33, and entry command in 50:34 form a convergence sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nearness, coming, return, entry, and staying; I infer reciprocal approach ending in residence, while the alternative is a simple sequence in which only the entrant truly moves.

changed_reading.before: Entrants traverse a one-way distance to a remote destination.
changed_reading.after: The destination has approached the returner; entry seals their convergence and turns repeated return into permanent residence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediate surplus beyond what is wished and the later denial of fatigue prevent الخلود from reading as static preservation: its duration can continue bearing increase without depletion.

activation_trace.role: Open duration supplies a temporal field larger than one daylight interval.
Persistence without rapid decay supplies continuity.
Increase and growth make continuity capable of positive addition.
Six bounded days provide the finite temporal counter-scale to the focus duration.
Negated weakness and fatigue supply a model of activity without exhaustion.

structural_cues: 50:35 places المزيد immediately after the focus; 50:38 couples bounded days with explicit non-fatigue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies persistence, added surplus, finite creation-days, and negated fatigue; I infer non-depleting generativity, while the live alternative confines non-fatigue to creation and treats المزيد as a separate gift.

changed_reading.before: Immortality is endless preservation of a completed state.
changed_reading.after: The day of permanence is an unspent duration: it neither wears out nor closes off further increase.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later day-images open the old enclosure, bring people out, collect them toward an outcome, and name a place of settlement; the focus entry is therefore the reverse boundary crossing, from a breached temporary container into an enduring interior.

activation_trace.role: Ingress supplies the final inward vector.
Stable persistence distinguishes the new interior from the opened earth.
Passage to the outside supplies the exact directional opposite of focus ingress.
A place of settlement or abode supplies the endpoint toward which motion resolves.
Splitting and opening make the earth a breached prior enclosure.
Driving and collecting a group toward a goal supplies the convergent middle movement.

structural_cues: 50:34 and 50:42 share the formula ذلك يوم while pairing entry/eternity with exit.
50:44 sequences earth-opening, rapid emergence, and gathering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opening, exit, gathering, destination, ingress, and permanence; I infer one container-reversal architecture, while the alternative reads 50:42-44 as later recapitulation rather than stages ordered around 50:34.

changed_reading.before: Admission is an isolated final welcome.
changed_reading.after: Admission completes a reversal: out of the split temporary enclosure, through gathering, and into a stable interior that will not be breached.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the commercial advance-sale branch of سلم is remote from the ordinary peace reading; it remains anchored in بسلام and the immediately preceding promise, but downstream prose should present it only as a contract-fulfillment resonance, not as a lexical replacement.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The سلم inventory includes an advance-payment transaction, and 50:32 identifies the destination as what had been promised.

activation_trace.role: An advance-payment sale supplies the remote transactional image of delivery after prior commitment.
A promise that opens expectation supplies the prior commitment now fulfilled.

changed_reading.before: بسلام only describes the peaceful manner of admission.
changed_reading.after: Admission also faintly resonates as delivery of what was pledged in advance: the promised destination is now handed over.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it folds an external destination into an inward register; it remains anchored in the focus branches of interiority and what settles in the heart plus 50:33's returning heart, but should be rendered as an inner echo of spatial entry, never its replacement.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: دخول can expose an interior or secret, الخلد can be what settles in the heart, and the preceding ayah names a returning heart.

activation_trace.role: Interiority and inward secret turn physical ingress into a secondary inward register.
What becomes settled in the heart supplies inward permanence.
Inner freedom from defect gives the settled inward state its quality.
The literal heart supplies the explicit context anchor for interiorization.
Repeated return supplies the heart's movement toward settled orientation.

changed_reading.before: The verse names only entry into an external enduring abode.
changed_reading.after: External admission echoes an inward completion: a repeatedly returning heart enters settled, lasting wholeness.

strongest_changes: The cast/enter opposition turns entry into welcomed crossing rather than punitive thrownness.
Nearness and return make entry reciprocal convergence followed by residence.
Exit, gathering, destination, and entry form a container reversal ending in a stable interior.
Surplus and non-fatigue make permanence open to increase rather than merely static.
summary.what_was_special: A five-word focus became a dense spatial-temporal mechanism: coercion versus welcome, exit versus entry, bounded days versus unspent duration; remote branches also exposed contained contract and heart-interior resonances.
remaining_uncertainties: The imperative alone does not prove voluntary agency; welcome is inferred from its contrast with casting and from سلام.
The surplus/non-fatigue link crosses distinct contexts and remains analogical.
The commercial and inward readings should remain secondary resonances.
